question: Create a volcano plot showing log2 fold change (x-axis) vs. -log10(p-value) (y-axis) for gene expression data. Highlight genes with |log2FC| > 1 and adjusted p-value < 0.05 in red. Annotate the top 5 most significant genes.

expected_output.description: log2 fold change as x-axis, -log10(p-value) as y-axis, significant genes highlighted, top 5 annotated by name
